Nõmme Südamekodu asub Tallinnas aadressil Hiiu tänav 42, endises Tervise Arengu Instituudi hoones, mis on põhjalikult ümber ehitatud tänapäevaseks eakatekoduks. Viiekorruselises hooneosas asuvad elanike toad, ühised puhke- ja tegevusruumid, kohvik ning ööpäevaringseks hoolduseks vajalikud ruumid.

estonia.title: EKSPERDI NIPID ⟩ Sinu lemmikparfüüm võib lõhnata veelgi paremini
estonia.description: Parfüüm on väga isiklik. Mõni jääb oma lemmiklõhnale truuks aastakümneteks, teine valib parfüümi vastavalt tujule või sündmusele, kolmas aga armastab katsetada ja täiendab oma lõhnakollektsiooni pidevalt uute leidudega.

estonia.title: KARM STATISTIKA ⟩ Üle 70 protsendi parimas eas Eesti meestest elab enese teadmata tiksuva tervisemurega
estonia.description: Autoga hoolduses käimine ja rehvivahetus on paljude meeste jaoks iseenesestmõistetav, tervisenäitajate kontrollimine aga mitte. Kui auto annab rikkest märgutulega teada, siis kõrge kolesterool või veresuhkur võib jääda pikaks ajaks märkamatuks. Statistika näitab, et meeste terviseanalüüsides esineb rohkelt kõrvalekaldeid juba noores eas.

estonia.title: AI abil naabrilastest lapspornot loonud ameeriklane mõisteti eluks ajaks vangi
estonia.description: Florida mees Daniel Warren kasutas tehisintellekti, et «disainida» naabruskonnas elavad lapsed pornograafilisse konteksti. Šerifi büroo sõnul oli nende jaoks tegemist esimese omataolise juhtumiga.

estonia.title: Trump läks vahevalimistele vastu rekordiliste kütusehindadega. Naftabossid naudivad rahasadu
estonia.description: USA president Donald Trump lubas valimiskampaania ajal langetada bensiinihinna kahe dollarini galloni eest, kuid tema teise ametiaja keskmine kütusehind on nüüdseks ületanud isegi Joe Bideni ametiaja tipptaseme. Kallinenud energia on kujunenud vabariiklastele tõsiseks valimisprobleemiks.

estonia.title: VIDEO ⟩ Luka Doncic jätkab NBAs ennenägematus hoos
estonia.description: Los Angeles Lakersi täht Luka Doncic on sel hooajal visanud keskmiselt 38,3 punkti. Tema selja taga haigutab sügavik.

estonia.title: USAs algasid tähtsad vahevalimised
estonia.description: Ameeriklased hääletavad täna tähtsatel vahevalimistel, kus demokraadid loodavad haarata kontrolli kongressi üle ja seada esimesi olulisi piiranguid Donald Trumpi teisele ametiajale Valges Majas.

estonia.title: Hanno Pevkur: enne kandideerimisotsust soovin rääkida Michaliga
estonia.description: Endine kaitseminister ja endine Reformierakonna esimees Hanno Pevkur ütleb, et pole veel otsustanud, kas kandideerib järgmisel kevadel riigikogu valimistel või mitte.

estonia.title: Pliiatsi ja isevalmistatud noaga kaasvangi tappa üritanud kurjategijad ristisid end Al Caponeks ja Don Antonioks
estonia.description: Korduvates vägivallakuritegudes süüdi mõistetud 30-aastane Deivis Kekišev ja 42-aastane Maivo Kärt on aastaid kandnud karistust vanglamüüride vahel, kuid nende vägivaldsed teod ei lõppenud sealgi. Mullu mõisteti need kaks meest süüdi kaasvangi mõrvakatses.

estonia.title: Koer pääses Hispaania rongiõnnetusest eluga, kuid peremees leiti surnuna
estonia.description: Hispaanias Toledo lähistel toimunud rängast rongiõnnetusest õnnestus eluga pääseda ühel koeral. Tema omanik oli kolm päeva kadunud, kuid leiti hiljem surnuna. Koer nimega Trece toimetati tagasi perekonna juurde.

estonia.title: Riik avab ukse tuhandetele välistöölistele, ametiühingud hoiatavad odava tööjõu eest
estonia.description: Ehkki senine sisserändekvoot jääb Eestis juba kolmandat aastat täitmata, avab riik järgmisest aastast välistööjõule uue kanali, mille kaudu võib tulla kuni 2569 töötajat. Ametiühingud hoiatavad, et madalam palganõue ja töötukassa loa kaotamine võivad muuta tööandjale kolmandatest riikidest odavama tööjõu palkamise ahvatlevamaks.

estonia.title: Tallinn müüb vanad puumajad ligi 800 000 euro eest EMTA-le
estonia.description: Tallinna linnavalitsus soovib müüa kesklinnas Sakala ja Tatari tänava nurgal asuva kinnistu 780 000 euro eest Eesti Muusika- ja Teatriakadeemiale (EMTA).

estonia.title: Tasa sõuad, kaugele jõuad – vanasõna, mis akutootjatele kõvasti sisse toob
estonia.description: Ameerika teadlased lõid uudse reaalajas mõõtmismeetodi, mis võimaldab liitiumioonakude esmast aktiveerimisaega lühendada kuni 60 protsenti. See akude tootmise üks kallemaid ja aeganõudvamaid etappe nõuab tavaliselt tohutult elektrit ja pinda, ent värske lahendus tõotab suurtööstusele tuua märgatava energiasäästu ning hoida kokku kuni sada miljonit dollarit aastas.

estonia.title: Tartu suunal saavad uued elektrirongid hakata sõitma veebruarist
estonia.description: Jaanuari keskpaigaks lõpevad Tartu suunal taristutööd ning Tallinnast Tartusse saab taas vähem kui kahe tunniga. Alates 1. veebruarist saavad Elroni uued Škoda elektrirongid Tallinna ja Tartu vahelisel raudteel liikuma hakata.

estonia.title: POSITIIVNE DOPINGUPROOV! ⟩ Fitnessivõistlusel debüteerinud Brigita Antonile määrati esialgne võistluskeeld: proovist leiti ka kokaiini
estonia.description: Kuu aega tagasi astus Brigita Anton kulturismi ja fitnessi Eesti meistrivõistlustel lavale. Eesti antidopingu ja spordieetika sihtasutus avaldab, et naise dopinguproov oli positiivne. Nüüd on talle määratud esialgne võistluskeeld.

estonia.title: KUKU ⟩ Kommusaare sõnul võib rändesurve külma saabudes taanduda ja kevadel taas suureneda
estonia.description: Tänases Kuku raadio saates «Sihik» oli külas politsei- ja piirivalveameti peadirektori asetäitja piirivalve alal Veiko Kommusaar, kelle sõnul on migratsioonisurve Eestile ajutiselt vähenenud.

estonia.title: PROBLEEM ⟩ Viidingu kirju avaldada ei tohi, aga kas küüditatute kirju võib?
estonia.description: Mihkel Muti kirjutatud raamat Juhan Viidingust kütab kirgi ja toob välja probleeme, millele tuleb lähiajaloo käsitlemisel mõelda, kirjutab kirjanik ja Eesti Kirjanike Liidu liige Erkki Koort.

estonia.title: «Ma ei hakanud teda ümber veenma.» Soufian Gouram on Eesti jalgpalli jaoks tõenäoliselt lõplikult kadunud
estonia.description: Eesti jalgpallikoondise peatreener Jürgen Henn rääkis teisipäevasel pressikonverentsil koondise koosseisu valikutest ning selgitas muu hulgas Saksamaa noortekoondise kasuks otsustanud Soufian Gourami ning rahvusmeeskonda naasva Rocco Robert Sheini olukorda.

estonia.title: Taani valitsus pahandas kliimaeesmärkide tõttu hooldekodudes vähem liha pakkuvate omavalitsustega
estonia.description: Taanis tekitab vaidlusi pealinna Kopenhaageni toitlustamisstrateegia, milles soovitatakse kliimaeesmärkide täitmisele viidates pakkuda hooldekodude elanikele liha tavapärasest vähem. Ministri sõnul ei ole tegemist kohustuste, vaid juhtnööridega, mis peavad jätma alles eakate õiguse ise oma toidulaua eest otsustada.

estonia.title: KUKU ⟩ Jüri Luik: Putinil puudub tegelik huvi sõja lõpetamiseks
estonia.description: Välisministeeriumi julgeolekupoliitika nõunik ja suursaadik Jüri Luik sõnas «Sihikus», et tema hinnangul ei pruugi vabariiklaste võimalik kaotus USA vahevalimistel riigi välis- ja julgeolekupoliitikat märkimisväärselt mõjutada.

estonia.title: VIKTORIA LADÕNSKAJA-KUBITS ⟩ Me seisame tunduvalt suurema kui relvastatud ohu probleemi lävel
estonia.description: Mida kauem sõda kestab, seda sügavamalt immutab see läbi kogu ühiskonna. Algsest kodaniku neutraalsusest võib aastate jooksul kujuneda hoopis vaikimisi toetav hoiak, sest tekib ka kaasosalemise nähtamatu seos. Kuid see ei ole ainukene keeruline küsimus Venemaa suhtes. Relvastatud konflikt on faas enne järgmist etappi – ideoloogilise sõja «headuse» mõiste eest, kirjutab kolumnist Viktoria Ladõnskaja-Kubits.

estonia.title: OTSE POSTIMEHEST ⟩ Millised on USA vahevalimiste tulemused? Stuudios on Andreas Kaju
estonia.description: Teisipäeval, 3. novembril toimuvad USA vahevalimised. Mis juhtus valimiste eel, kuidas ameeriklased hääletasid ja milliseid muutusi võib valimiste tulemus kaasa tuua, sellest räägime Postimehe otsesaates USA eksperdi Andreas Kajuga.

estonia.title: SUUR SEGADUS ⟩ Riia keskturu lihasaali kauplejatele öeldi, et neil pole mõtet homme tööle tulla
estonia.description: Riia keskturgu ootavad ees suured muudatused. Riia linnavolikogu andis turu haldurile SIA Rīgas nami'le rohelise tule võtta enam kui 22 miljonit eurot laenu, et turg täielikult renoveerida, teatas Läti televisioon 2. novembril.

estonia.title: ANALÜÜS ⟩ Sotsid: uusi ideid meil ei ole, aga see-eest on meil Lennart Mere tsitaadid
estonia.description: Jonatan Vseviovi «troonikõne» nädalavahetuse Sotsiaaldemokraatliku Erakonna volikogul oli tema senistest esinemistest kõige nõrgem.

latvia.title: EU to host Ukraine reconstruction talks with US and UK
latvia.description: France, Germany, the U.K., NATO and the World Bank will join representatives from Washington, Kyiv and the EU in Brussels.

latvia.title: Divided Bulgaria votes in tense presidential runoff
latvia.description: The first round in the European Union and NATO member state was marked by record-low turnout

latvia.title: Latvia, the Netherlands to host new European Drone Technology Hubs
latvia.description: The Latvian centre will focus on air and land drones, the one in the Netherlands on maritime assets

latvia.title: Alakul a botrány Amerikában: akár meg is akadályozhatják az egyik szenátor beiktatását
latvia.description: Komoly esély van arra, hogy a demokrata párti Mary Peltola még a győzelme esetén sem foglalhatja el a helyét az amerikai szenátusban – jelentette ki James Comer republikánus képviselő, a felügyeleti bizottság elnöke. Peltola kampánycsapata sajtóhírek szerint egy névrokon elindításával próbálta megosztani a republikánus szavazatokat - írta a The Hill .

latvia.title: Azonnali hatállyal menesztették Feledy Botondot - Reagált a Külügyi Intézet kirúgott vezérigazgatója; Magyar Péter is megszólalt az ügyben
latvia.description: Velkey György László, a Külügyminisztérium parlamenti államtitkára szűkszavú Facebook-posztban jelentette be, hogy menesztik a Magyar Külügyi Intézet nemrég kinevezett vezérigazgatóját, Feledy Botondot. Nem sokkal később Feledy Botond is reagált Facebook-posztban, elmondta: külpolitikai elemző cége a Lázár János vezette Építési és Közlekedési Minisztériumnak is dolgozott. Ezt már maga Magyar Péter miniszterelnök sem hagyta szóm nélkül, majd Feledy Botond Facebook-bejegyzése alatt beszélgetésbe fogtak egymással az érintettek. Közben az is kiderült, hogy milyen feladatokat végzett Feledy cége a volt miniszternek.

latvia.title: Tri operácie za pár týždňov. Britské námorníctvo sleduje čoraz aktívnejšie ruské lode
latvia.description: Britské kráľovské námorníctvo sledovalo ruskú spravodajskú loď Viktor Leonov, ktorá monitorovala vojenské cvičenie Organizácie Severoatlantickej zmluvy (NATO) pri pobreží Škótska. O operácii informovalo námorníctvo v pondelok 2. novembra v čase rastúcich obáv západných krajín z ruskej špionáže a hybridných operácií v Európe.

latvia.title: Európa ukazuje, že to myslí vážne. Vojenské jednotky sa pripravujú na možný vstup na Ukrajinu
latvia.description: Približne 2800 vojakov z desiatich európskych krajín sa v novembri zúčastní na prvom cvičení mnohonárodných síl určených na podporu Ukrajiny. Oznámili to v pondelok Francúzsko a Spojené kráľovstvo, ktoré tieto medzinárodné jednotky (MNF-U) vedú. Informovala o tom agentúra AFP.

latvia.title: NATO cvičí přesun a zásobování tisíců vojáků
latvia.description: V Lotyšsku se koná dosud největší cvičení mezinárodní brigády NATO v zemi. Operace Resolute Reforger 2026 prověřuje schopnost aliančních jednotek přesouvat se na velké vzdálenosti a udržet bojeschopnost v náročných podmínkách. Do cvičení, které potrvá do 8. listopadu, se zapojilo přibližně 3 tisíce a tisíc kusů vojenské techniky. Vojáci testují logistické, zdravotnické i vojenské policejní zabezpečení jednotek v terénu. Jednou z hlavních výzev je zásobování bojových jednotek v první linii palivem, potravinami a vodou prostřednictvím sítě logistických stanovišť. Cvičení zahrnuje i operace v realistických podmínkách včetně civilních oblastí východního Lotyšska.

latvia.title: Guvernatoarea statului New Jersey avertizează porturile SUA: Importul de motorină rusească este ilegal, în ciuda acordului Trump-Putin
latvia.description: Guvernatoarea statului american New Jersey, Mikie Sherrill, a avertizat operatorii portuari că importul de motorină din Rusia rămâne ilegal, în ciuda acordului anunțat luna trecută de Donald Trump și Vladimir Putin privind reluarea exporturilor de combustibil rusesc către piața americană. Într-o scrisoare deschisă, Sherrill a susținut că înțelegerea încalcă o lege federală adoptată în 2022 și a amenințat cu sancțiuni civile și penale companiile care ar accepta astfel de transporturi, anunță TVP World.

latvia.title: Daniel Fried, fost ambasador al SUA: „Sondajele sugerează un val albastru, dar nu aș da asta în scris”
latvia.description: Cu o zi înainte de alegerile care pot schimba controlul asupra Congresului american, unul dintre cei mai experimentați diplomați americani refuză să prevadă un val albastru. „Ultimele sondaje par să-l sugereze, dar nu aș da asta în scris”, spune Daniel Fried, fost ambasador al SUA și expert al Atlantic Council, într-un interviu acordat Digi24 la Washington. Fried, care a lucrat pentru George W. Bush la aderarea României la NATO, are și un mesaj pentru București: ideea că democrații americani ar fi mai reci față de România „nu este adevărată”.

latvia.title: Atacurile din Marea Neagră devin o provocare pentru NATO și lasă România și Bulgaria expuse: „Este vorba despre a testa liniile roșii”
latvia.description: După cele șapte atacuri asupra unor nave de marfă în apropierea statelor membre NATO România și Bulgaria, care au avut loc luna trecută, alianța militară condusă de SUA a anunțat că va desfășura avioane de patrulare maritimă, radare și drone pentru a-și consolida flancul estic în Marea Neagră, notează Reuters.

latvia.title: Ce afaceri de familie sunt în spatele negociatorilor de pace americani și ruși privind războiul din Ucraina
latvia.description: Publicația Kyiv Post a urmărit rețelele de afaceri de familie din jurul negociatorilor de pace de la Washington și Moscova. Legăturile se întind de la un om de afaceri cu legături la Kremlin, care a contribuit la finanțarea nunții lui Trump Jr., până la o afacere cu criptomonede a familiei Trump. Senatorii americani afirmă că acea afacere a vândut token-uri unui cumpărător legat de un instrument rus de eludare a sancțiunilor, însă nu se știe încă cui aparține acel portofel.

latvia.title: Un avion de vânătoare rusesc de ultimă generație Su-57 a sărit în aer când pornea motoarele. Care a fost cauza (GUR)
latvia.description: Un avion de vânătoare rusesc de ultimă generație, Su-57, a explodat la sfârșitul lunii octombrie pe un aerodrom militar, susține spionajul militar ucrainean. Potrivit Direcției de Informații a Ministerului Apărării din Ucraina (GUR), incidentul ar fi fost cauzat de calitatea proastă a combustibilului folosit.

latvia.title: „20 de euro pentru fiecare porc crescut în gospodărie”. Tanczos Barna anunță ajutoare pentru crescători (proiect)
latvia.description: Senatul a adoptat luni o propunere legislativă pentru sprijinirea gospodăriilor şi fermelor comerciale mici în prevenirea răspândirii pestei porcine africane, a anunţat senatorul UDMR Tanczos Barna, inițiatorul proiectului. Documentul merge la Camera Deputaţilor, for decizional în acest caz.

latvia.title: Cinci senatori aleşi pe listele POT şi S.O.S. România s-au afliat grupului PSD
latvia.description: Cinci senatori aleşi în Parlament pe listele POT şi S.O.S România şi-au anunţat, luni, în plenul Senatului, afilierea la grupul Partidului Social Democrat.

latvia.title: Trafic blocat pe ambele sensuri pe bulevardul Metalurgiei din București, după ce un copac a căzut și a doborât un stâlp electric
latvia.description: Traficul rutier este restricționat luni pe bulevardul Metalurgiei, unde un copac a căzut pe carosabil și a doborât un stâlp de electricitate, a anunțat Brigada Rutieră a Capitalei.

latvia.title: Trump caută țapi ispășitori pentru eșecul răsunător al războiului cu Iranul. Capul cui ar putea să cadă „pe altarul” liderului SUA
latvia.description: Războiul cu Iranul, care s-a prelungit mai mult de opt luni și a dus la creșterea prețurilor la combustibil în SUA până la niveluri record, i-a costat scump pe Donald Trump și pe republicani. Aceștia riscă să piardă alegerile intermediare pentru Congres, înaintea cărora președintele a promis că nu va relua acțiunile militare împotriva Iranului. Pentru perioada de după alegeri, a fost pregătit un plan de lansare a unor atacuri și mai masive asupra Iranului, care, după cum se tem țările din Golful Persic, vor duce la distrugeri și mai mari și la destabilizarea regiunii, scriu Bloomberg și Financial Times.

latvia.title: Exit-poll în Bulgaria: candidata pro-rusă Iliana Iotova conduce în alegerile prezidențiale, cu 57,4% din voturi
latvia.description: Iliana Iotova este pe cale să obțină un mandat de cinci ani la conducerea Bulgariei, potrivit primelor exit-poll-uri publicate la închiderea urnelor. Candidata susținută de formațiunea premierului Rumen Radev conduce în fața lui Andrei Ghiurov, care a mizat pe o platformă pro-occidentală și pe apropierea de UE și NATO, potrivit Novinite.

latvia.title: Rețea de hoți care deturnau transporturi de marfă în România și Europa, destructurată de DIICOT
latvia.description: DIICOT a făcut 65 de percheziții într-un dosar care vizează o grupare acuzată că ar fi furat aproximativ 70 de transporturi de marfă din România și alte țări europene, în special din Belgia, transmite Mediafax. Procurorii DIICOT și polițiștii de la Brigada de Combatere a Criminalității Organizate Pitești au făcut, marți, 3 noiembrie, 65 de […] © G4Media.ro .

latvia.title: PPA: Illegal immigration to Estonia has fallen, but may rise next spring
latvia.description: The number of migrants crossing from Belarus into Latvia and Estonia has fallen over the last week, but the Police and Border Guard Board (PPA) already expects the problems to return in the spring.

latvia.title: Latvia's insolvent Valka stops cooperation programs with Estonia's Valga
latvia.description: Cross-border cooperation projects between Estonia's Valga and Latvia's Valka have been suspended as the Latvian municipality is insolvent and must undergo a financial restructuring process.

latvia.title: Estonian border guards could be given additional powers to stop migrants
latvia.description: Estonian border guards could be given additional powers to stop border violators, Minister of Interior Igor Taro (Eesti 200) has said, after meeting with his Latvian counterpart.

latvia.title: Estonian raw milk producer buys Latvia's largest dairy company
latvia.description: Estonia's largest agricultural group, Agrone, on Friday finalized a deal to buy Latvia's largest dairy companies, Rīgas piena kombināts and Valmieras piens.

latvia.title: SUUR SEGADUS ⟩ Riia keskturu lihasaali kauplejatele öeldi, et neil pole mõtet homme tööle tulla
latvia.description: Riia keskturgu ootavad ees suured muudatused. Riia linnavolikogu andis turu haldurile SIA Rīgas nami'le rohelise tule võtta enam kui 22 miljonit eurot laenu, et turg täielikult renoveerida, teatas Läti televisioon 2. novembril.

latvia.title: President Edgars Rinkēvičs' opening speech to the 15th Saeima
latvia.description: On Tuesday, November 3rd, the first sitting of the 15th Saeima (parliament) took place in Rīga. Proceedings were kicked off by President Edgars Rinkēvičs, who addressed the newly-assembled deputies with the speech below [Please note this is an unofficial translation. We'll update it with an official translation if one appears].

latvia.title: Man detained in central Rīga on suspicion of selling drugs in broad daylight
latvia.description: On 23 October, shortly before 1.00 pm, the attention of staff at the Rīga City Council Municipal Police CCTV centre was drawn to a group of people in Vērmane Park, one of whom was allegedly dealing in narcotic substances.

latvia.title: WATCH: Latvia lays out its plans for the United Nations Security Council
latvia.description: Latvia takes the helm of the United Nations Security Council (UNSC) throughout November, the first time ever that it has had that responsibility.

latvia.title: Latvia signs up to European Defence Alliance in Paris
latvia.description: Latvia joined the European Defence Alliance in Paris on November 2nd to expand cooperation between Latvian defence industry companies and European partners.

latvia.title: 'Baltic Fraud Lab' is coming in December
latvia.description: On December 17th, Rīga will host what is described as "the first ever practical fraud and corruption risk investigation laboratory in Latvia – BALTIC FRAUD LAB 2026."

latvia.title: RSU to host Innovation Day this week
latvia.description: On 5th November, from 09:00 to 17:00, Rīga Stradiņš University (RSU) will be hosting Innovation Day, inviting visitors to discover entrepreneurial experiences, emerging technologies and research solutions for healthcare and sport.

latvia.title: WATCH LIVE: First sitting of the 15th Latvian Saeima
latvia.description: Tuesday, November 3rd sees the first sitting of the 15th Saeima, following national elections one month ago. In accordance with the Constitution of the Republic of Latvia, the newly elected Saeima convenes for its first session on the first Tuesday of November, when the term of office of the previous Saeima also ends.

latvia.title: Older voters happiest with election results, survey suggests
latvia.description: Older people are more satisfied with the results of last month's 15th Saeima elections, according to a new survey. Younger voters are more sceptical about the outcome of this election, while residents aged 60 and over are the most satisfied, according to the survey carried out by the research agency Norstat which asked for the views of 1,001 people across Latvia, aged 18 to 74.

latvia.title: House renovation slow and slower in Latvia
latvia.description: The renovation of blocks of flats in Latvia is still progressing slowly, even though thousands of buildings are in need of refurbishment. Funding for the existing state support programmes has already been allocated, but the terms of the new programme may be less favourable for residents, Latvian Television reported on November 2.

latvia.title: Concert attendance noticeably down in Latvia
latvia.description: In the first nine months of 2026, attendance at concerts and other musical events fell by 23.5 per cent compared with the same period the previous year, according to AKKA/LAA data published on November 2.

latvia.title: Rīga Central Market renovation plan gets green light
latvia.description: Changes are on the horizon for Rīga Central Market – Rīga City Council has given the green light for manager “Rīgas nami” to borrow more than 22 million euros to renovate the market, Latvian Television reported on November 2.

latvia.title: Latvia begins cattle exports via Rīga Airport
latvia.description: Cattle exports have begun at Riga International Airport – animals reared in Latvia are being flown to Central Asian countries. Three flights have now taken place, Latvian Television reported on November 3.

latvia.title: Sunny weather expected in Latvia Tuesday
latvia.description: Forecasts suggest that sunny weather is expected in many parts of Latvia on Tuesday.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 2nd November, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Air threat alert in Latvia's Balvi, Ludza municipalities is over
latvia.description: Latvia's National Armed Forces (NBS) issued an orange level alert at around midnight on Tuesday, November 3, over a potential threat to Latvian airspace. The threat was declared over at 0:33.

latvia.title: Traffic near fire in Sarkandaugava to be restricted this week
latvia.description: On Monday morning, a fire broke out in an unoccupied building on Tvaika Street, but traffic near the building will be closed for at least a week whilst structural engineers assess the stability of the external walls and a solution is found to eliminate the hazard, the Rīga City Council has announced.

latvia.title: Latvia among EU's low spenders on social protection benefits
latvia.description: Fresh data from Eurostat suggests that potential cost-cutting measures by the incoming government will come against a background in which Latvia already has one of the lowest levels of spending on social protection in the the European Union.

latvia.title: 'Drone for Latvia, drone for Ukraine' calls fundraising campaign
latvia.description: ‘A drone for Latvia, a drone for Ukraine.’ This is the slogan for the latest fundraising campaign. Throughout November, everyone is invited to support the purchase of drones for both the Ukrainian army and the Latvian National Guard, Latvian Radio and Latvian Television reported.

latvia.title: RFS wins a fourth Latvian football league title
latvia.description: The long-time leaders of the Latvian Football League (Virslīga), RFS, defeated Grobiņa 3:0 in Riga on Sunday, November 1st, and in the process secured a fourth Latvian league title for themselves.

latvia.title: Outgoing Latvian health minister quits party after 16 years
latvia.description: Outgoing Health Minister Hossams Abu Meri has decided to resign from the Unity political party (which technically sits within the slightly broader 'New Unity' political force) according to a statement on his Facebook account.

latvia.title: Riga Airport is looking for investors
latvia.description: RIX Riga Airport has launched a competitive selection process for the development of aircraft maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) hangars on the airport's territory, it announced on November 2nd.

latvia.title: NATO demonstrates its 'digital backbone' again in Latvia
latvia.description: NATO’s Digital Backbone eXperimentation (DiBaX 2026) took place in Latvia from October 19-30, under the leadership of NATO Allied Command Transformation (ACT), supported by the Latvian Ministry of Defence and the National Armed Forces, with LMT Defence as the technicalintegrator. It is a NATO experiment aimed at enhancing interoperability across domains through cutting-edge 5G and satellite communication technologies.

latvia.title: Latvia sends 'mobile surveillance device' to eastern border
latvia.description: Latvia's National Armed Forces (NBS) have deployed a first new "mobile surveillance device" on the Latvian state border to the Krāslava region, the NBS said in a release on November 2nd.

latvia.title: Latvia plans to buy Canadian 'Hellbender' helmets
latvia.description: Latvia's National Defence Logistics and Acquisition Centre (VALIC) has agreed with Canadian defence equipment manufacturer Galvion on the supply of "tactical helmet systems" for the National Armed Forces.

latvia.title: All Latvian electric trains now have names
latvia.description: The naming of the “Vivi” electric trains has been completed – the last four have now been given their names. Passengers will be carried by Lūsis (Lynx), Dzenis (Woodpecker), Kļava (Maple) and Alnis (Moose). This means that all 32 electric trains have now been named.

latvia.title: Latvian Prime Minister Kulbergs enjoys his rally passion with weekend win
latvia.description: While the attention of most of the motorsports world over the weekend was focussed on the crowning of the youngest ever Formula 1 world champion, Kimi Antonelli, 20, at the Mexican Grand Prix, there was a slightly slower motor race being run in the suburbs of Rīga involving a slightly older but no less remarkable personality.

latvia.title: Some nights will be frosty in Latvia this week
latvia.description: There will be no major changes in the weather this week, but forecasts suggest that on some nights the temperature will dip slightly below zero.

latvia.title: Rural tourism was pretty popular this summer in Latvia
latvia.description: Rural tourism has not seen a significant drop in bookings or visitor numbers this summer, although guests have become more frugal when it comes to dining. Despite a significant rise in costs, business owners are increasing food prices cautiously, Latvian Radio reported on November 2.

latvia.title: Traffic restricted in Rīga, Sarkandaugava due to fire Monday morning
latvia.description: On Monday morning, a fire broke out in an unoccupied building on Tvaika Street in Riga, and the road has been closed at the start of the street, according to the State Fire and Rescue Service (VUGD).

latvia.title: Bauska getting a head start on Christmas tree shopping
latvia.description: Although there are still just under two months to go until Christmas, Bauska is already thinking about the festive season. Residents have decided that, after a break of several years, a real Christmas tree will once again be erected in the town’s Town Hall Square. However, the change will not take place until next year, Zemgale Regional Television reported on November 2.

latvia.title: Grass growing under Latvian AI centre's feet
latvia.description: Latvia's Artificial Intelligence Centre (MIC) was established last April. The centre’s first director, Natālija Čerņecka, was appointed to the post last October and remained in the post for four months. She was succeeded by Guna Puce, who has not yet been in the post for a year. And now, once again, there is talk of structural changes at the centre, Latvian Television's De Facto reported on November 1.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 1st November, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Latvia takes charge of the United Nations Security Council for first time
latvia.description: November 1st, 2026 is an historic day, as for the first time ever Latvia will hold the presidency of the UN Security Council (UNSC). During this month, Latvia will chair all informal and formal UNSC meetings.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: October 31st, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Air alert in Ludza and Krāslava municipalities of Latvia is over
latvia.description: Latvia's National Armed Forces (NBS) issued a warning covering Ludza and Krāslava municipalities regarding a threat to airspace on Sunday evening at 18:57, but it was withdrawn fairly quickly.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 30th October 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Baltic defence industry gains momentum
latvia.description: The defence industry across the Baltic states is growing significantly. The number of companies and employees has increased, revenues have risen and investment is expanding. lithuania.description: Komoly esély van arra, hogy a demokrata párti Mary Peltola még a győzelme esetén sem foglalhatja el a helyét az amerikai szenátusban – jelentette ki James Comer republikánus képviselő, a felügyeleti bizottság elnöke. lithuania.title: Poľsko mobilizovalo sily pri Rusku. Tusk hovorí o zmarenej provokácii
lithuania.description: Nočné hlásenie pohraničnej stráže vyvolalo mobilizáciu poľských bezpečnostných síl pri ruskej Kaliningradskej oblasti. Podľa premiéra Donalda Tuska sa podarilo zabrániť pokusu o provokáciu. Poľsko pritom už predtým posilnilo severovýchodnú hranicu po varovaniach pred diverziami a možným prienikom ozbrojených skupín.

lithuania.title: Tri operácie za pár týždňov. Britské námorníctvo sleduje čoraz aktívnejšie ruské lode
lithuania.description: Britské kráľovské námorníctvo sledovalo ruskú spravodajskú loď Viktor Leonov, ktorá monitorovala vojenské cvičenie Organizácie Severoatlantickej zmluvy (NATO) pri pobreží Škótska. O operácii informovalo námorníctvo v pondelok 2. novembra v čase rastúcich obáv západných krajín z ruskej špionáže a hybridných operácií v Európe.

lithuania.title: Európa ukazuje, že to myslí vážne. Vojenské jednotky sa pripravujú na možný vstup na Ukrajinu
lithuania.description: Približne 2800 vojakov z desiatich európskych krajín sa v novembri zúčastní na prvom cvičení mnohonárodných síl určených na podporu Ukrajiny. Oznámili to v pondelok Francúzsko a Spojené kráľovstvo, ktoré tieto medzinárodné jednotky (MNF-U) vedú. Informovala o tom agentúra AFP.

lithuania.title: NATO cvičí přesun a zásobování tisíců vojáků
lithuania.description: V Lotyšsku se koná dosud největší cvičení mezinárodní brigády NATO v zemi. Operace Resolute Reforger 2026 prověřuje schopnost aliančních jednotek přesouvat se na velké vzdálenosti a udržet bojeschopnost v náročných podmínkách. Do cvičení, které potrvá do 8. listopadu, se zapojilo přibližně 3 tisíce a tisíc kusů vojenské techniky. Vojáci testují logistické, zdravotnické i vojenské policejní zabezpečení jednotek v terénu. Jednou z hlavních výzev je zásobování bojových jednotek v první linii palivem, potravinami a vodou prostřednictvím sítě logistických stanovišť. Cvičení zahrnuje i operace v realistických podmínkách včetně civilních oblastí východního Lotyšska.

lithuania.title: Guvernatoarea statului New Jersey avertizează porturile SUA: Importul de motorină rusească este ilegal, în ciuda acordului Trump-Putin
lithuania.description: Guvernatoarea statului american New Jersey, Mikie Sherrill, a avertizat operatorii portuari că importul de motorină din Rusia rămâne ilegal, în ciuda acordului anunțat luna trecută de Donald Trump și Vladimir Putin privind reluarea exporturilor de combustibil rusesc către piața americană. Într-o scrisoare deschisă, Sherrill a susținut că înțelegerea încalcă o lege federală adoptată în 2022 și a amenințat cu sancțiuni civile și penale companiile care ar accepta astfel de transporturi, anunță TVP World.

lithuania.title: Daniel Fried, fost ambasador al SUA: „Sondajele sugerează un val albastru, dar nu aș da asta în scris”
lithuania.description: Cu o zi înainte de alegerile care pot schimba controlul asupra Congresului american, unul dintre cei mai experimentați diplomați americani refuză să prevadă un val albastru. „Ultimele sondaje par să-l sugereze, dar nu aș da asta în scris”, spune Daniel Fried, fost ambasador al SUA și expert al Atlantic Council, într-un interviu acordat Digi24 la Washington. Fried, care a lucrat pentru George W. Bush la aderarea României la NATO, are și un mesaj pentru București: ideea că democrații americani ar fi mai reci față de România „nu este adevărată”.

lithuania.title: Atacurile din Marea Neagră devin o provocare pentru NATO și lasă România și Bulgaria expuse: „Este vorba despre a testa liniile roșii”
lithuania.description: După cele șapte atacuri asupra unor nave de marfă în apropierea statelor membre NATO România și Bulgaria, care au avut loc luna trecută, alianța militară condusă de SUA a anunțat că va desfășura avioane de patrulare maritimă, radare și drone pentru a-și consolida flancul estic în Marea Neagră, notează Reuters.

lithuania.title: Ce afaceri de familie sunt în spatele negociatorilor de pace americani și ruși privind războiul din Ucraina
lithuania.description: Publicația Kyiv Post a urmărit rețelele de afaceri de familie din jurul negociatorilor de pace de la Washington și Moscova. Legăturile se întind de la un om de afaceri cu legături la Kremlin, care a contribuit la finanțarea nunții lui Trump Jr., până la o afacere cu criptomonede a familiei Trump. Senatorii americani afirmă că acea afacere a vândut token-uri unui cumpărător legat de un instrument rus de eludare a sancțiunilor, însă nu se știe încă cui aparține acel portofel.

lithuania.title: Un avion de vânătoare rusesc de ultimă generație Su-57 a sărit în aer când pornea motoarele. Care a fost cauza (GUR)
lithuania.description: Un avion de vânătoare rusesc de ultimă generație, Su-57, a explodat la sfârșitul lunii octombrie pe un aerodrom militar, susține spionajul militar ucrainean. Potrivit Direcției de Informații a Ministerului Apărării din Ucraina (GUR), incidentul ar fi fost cauzat de calitatea proastă a combustibilului folosit.

lithuania.title: „20 de euro pentru fiecare porc crescut în gospodărie”. Tanczos Barna anunță ajutoare pentru crescători (proiect)
lithuania.description: Senatul a adoptat luni o propunere legislativă pentru sprijinirea gospodăriilor şi fermelor comerciale mici în prevenirea răspândirii pestei porcine africane, a anunţat senatorul UDMR Tanczos Barna, inițiatorul proiectului. Documentul merge la Camera Deputaţilor, for decizional în acest caz.

lithuania.title: Cinci senatori aleşi pe listele POT şi S.O.S. România s-au afliat grupului PSD
lithuania.description: Cinci senatori aleşi în Parlament pe listele POT şi S.O.S România şi-au anunţat, luni, în plenul Senatului, afilierea la grupul Partidului Social Democrat.

lithuania.title: Trump caută țapi ispășitori pentru eșecul răsunător al războiului cu Iranul. Capul cui ar putea să cadă „pe altarul” liderului SUA
lithuania.description: Războiul cu Iranul, care s-a prelungit mai mult de opt luni și a dus la creșterea prețurilor la combustibil în SUA până la niveluri record, i-a costat scump pe Donald Trump și pe republicani. Aceștia riscă să piardă alegerile intermediare pentru Congres, înaintea cărora președintele a promis că nu va relua acțiunile militare împotriva Iranului. Pentru perioada de după alegeri, a fost pregătit un plan de lansare a unor atacuri și mai masive asupra Iranului, care, după cum se tem țările din Golful Persic, vor duce la distrugeri și mai mari și la destabilizarea regiunii, scriu Bloomberg și Financial Times.

lithuania.title: Exit-poll în Bulgaria: candidata pro-rusă Iliana Iotova conduce în alegerile prezidențiale, cu 57,4% din voturi
lithuania.description: Iliana Iotova este pe cale să obțină un mandat de cinci ani la conducerea Bulgariei, potrivit primelor exit-poll-uri publicate la închiderea urnelor. Candidata susținută de formațiunea premierului Rumen Radev conduce în fața lui Andrei Ghiurov, care a mizat pe o platformă pro-occidentală și pe apropierea de UE și NATO, potrivit Novinite.

lithuania.title: NATO demonstrates its 'digital backbone' again in Latvia
lithuania.description: NATO’s Digital Backbone eXperimentation (DiBaX 2026) took place in Latvia from October 19-30, under the leadership of NATO Allied Command Transformation (ACT), supported by the Latvian Ministry of Defence and the National Armed Forces, with LMT Defence as the technicalintegrator. It is a NATO experiment aimed at enhancing interoperability across domains through cutting-edge 5G and satellite communication technologies.

lithuania.title: Report: U.S. pressures Baltics not to say nasty things about Russia
lithuania.description: Pentagon officials have urged several NATO allies, including the Baltic states, to tone down their public rhetoric about the threat posed by Russia, arguing that some statements by European leaders and official have undermined the continent’s security, according to Lithuanian public media LRT, citing a Reuters report.

lithuania.title: NATO minesweepers arrive in Liepāja port
lithuania.description: On October 30th, two ships of the Standing NATO Maritime Mine Countermeasures Group 1 (SNMCMG1) arrived in the port of Liepāja.

lithuania.title: Railways more popular in Latvia than in Estonia or Lithuania
lithuania.description: New Eurostat data published on October 29th confirms that Latvians like to use their railways more than their neighbours to the north and south.

lithuania.title: Zelenskis pats sarežģījis attiecības ar Trampu – nosaukta viņa lielākā kļūda
lithuania.description: Amerikāņu aktīviste Lora Lūmere uzskata, ka Ukrainas prezidents Volodimirs Zelenskis pieļāvis būtisku kļūdu attiecībās ar ASV prezidentu Donaldu Trampu. lithuania.title: Lukašenko paredz drīzu kara noslēgumu Ukrainā, taču izsaka arī biedējošu brīdinājumu
lithuania.description: Baltkrievijas pašpasludinātais prezidents Aleksandrs Lukašenko izteicies, ka karš Ukrainā varētu beigties jau tuvāko mēnešu laikā. Viņš apgalvo, ka abām pusēm pietrūkst spēka un resursu, lai turpinātu karadarbību, vēsta Ukrainas medijs. Lukašenko šādu paziņojumu izteicis 3. novembrī konferencē par Eirāzijas drošību Minskā. lithuania.description: Nepālas Himalajos, netālu no pasaulē augstākā kalna Everesta bāzes nometnes, notikusi smaga aviokatastrofa – nolaišanās laikā sadūrušies divi helikopteri. lithuania.title: Pēc Krievijas trieciena Ukrainai Latvija sasauc ANO Drošības padomes ārkārtas sēdi

lithuania.description: Krievijas diktators Vladimirs Putins steidz panākt Maskavai izdevīgu vienošanos par Ukrainu, jo ASV Kongresa vēlēšanas var ierobežot prezidenta Donalda Trampa iespējas ietekmēt Vašingtonas atbalsta politiku Kijivai. lithuania.description: Aizvadītā nedēļa miera sarunām par kara izbeigšanu Ukrainā sākusies nelāgi gan Krievijas diktators Vladimirs Putins, gan Ukrainas prezidents Volodimirs Zelenskis nākuši klajā ar paziņojumiem, kas būtiski atšķiras un apgrūtina iespēju panākt vienošanos. lithuania.title: Melania Trump Baltuosiuose rūmuose žada priimti Ukrainos ir Rusijos atstovus
lithuania.description: JAV pirmoji ponia Melania Trump (Melanija Tramp) Vašingtone priims Rusijos ir Ukrainos atstovus, antradienį pranešė Baltieji rūmai.

lithuania.title: Patikrų Kauno apskrities kapinių prieigose rezultatai – įkliuvo ne vienas, neturintis teisės vairuoti
lithuania.description: Kauno apskrities vyriausiojo policijos komisariato (VPK) Kelių policijos skyriaus pareigūnai praėjusią savaitę mobiliaisiais greičio matavimo prietaisais užfiksavo 509 greičio viršijimo atvejus. Savaitgalį didesnis dėmesys skirtas kapinių prieigoms – išaiškintas ne vienas vairuotojas, neturėjęs tą dieną sėsti prie vairo.

lithuania.title: Iranas užsiminė apie kerštą JAV: „Mūsų raketos pasiektų Europą“
lithuania.description: Iranas gali išplėsti potencialių smūgių geografiją ir pulti JAV karinius objektus Europoje, jei Vašingtonas duos įsakymą atnaujinti karinę operaciją, Laisvės radijui pareiškė Irano parlamento narys, buvęs užsienio reikalų ministras Manouchehras Mottakis.

lithuania.title: Irano prezidentas Masoudas Pezeshkianas: karo su JAV atsinaujinimas nenaudingas niekam
lithuania.description: Irano prezidentas Masoudas Pezeshkianas (Masudas Pezeškianas) antradienį pareiškė, kad atsinaujinusios kovos su JAV nebūtų naudingos niekam, ir pakartojo, jog jo vyriausybei buvo suteikti nauji derybiniai įgaliojimai bendraujant su Vašingtonu.

lithuania.title: Mokslininkai: kodėl vis dar veikia švietimo sistema?
lithuania.description: Nuolat kalbame apie nesibaigiančias švietimo reformas – jų nenuoseklumą, kartais nepagrįstumą, trumpalaikiškumą. Dažniausiai tai yra susiję su mokykline sistema, būtent mokyklų bendruomenės tampa reformų įgyvendintojomis. Kyla klausimas, ar reformos turi ilgalaikį pozityvų poveikį? Gal tai yra tik išteklių ir energijos švaistymas?

lithuania.title: Anksčiau dažnai buvo matomas netoli populiarių parduotuvių, o prieš savaitę – staiga dingo
lithuania.description: Alytaus policijos pareigūnai ieško dingusiojo Broniaus Butrimo. Prašoma ir visuomenės pagalbos.

lithuania.title: Prancūzijoje moksleiviai užblokavo dešimtis vidurinių mokyklų
lithuania.description: Siekdami išlaikyti spaudimą vyriausybei dėl švietimo reformų, moksleiviai antradienį visoje Prancūzijoje užblokavo dešimtis vidurinių mokyklų, profesinėms sąjungoms ruošiantis vėliau šią savaitę vyksiančiam visuotiniam streikui.

lithuania.title: Kaip savo 100-ąjį jubiliejų pasitinka pats Valdas Adamkus?
lithuania.description: Prezidentas Valdas Adamkus antradienį mini savo 100-ąjį gimtadienį. Paaiškėjo, kur šį išskirtinį jubiliejų pasitinka pats kadenciją baigęs šalies vadovas.

lithuania.title: Lenkijos eksprezidentas: Lietuva – laimės kūdikis, jog jai vadovavo Valdas Adamkus
lithuania.description: Buvęs Lenkijos prezidentas Aleksandras Kwasniewskis sako, kad Lietuva buvo laimės kūdikis, jog turėjo tokį skirtingas šalies istorinės raidos patirtis jungiantį prezidentą kaip Valdas Adamkus.

lithuania.title: Įtartiną „Toyota RAV4“ policija sekė Vilniaus senamiestyje: pareigūnai tarsi juto, kad reikia jį iškratyti
lithuania.description: Lapkričio 1-osios vakarą Vilniuje Kelių policijos skyriaus pareigūnams įkliuvo užsienietis turistas. Sustabdžius įtartinai manevruojantį automobilį, jame ir pas keleivį rasta, kaip įtariama, narkotinių medžiagų. Pradėtas ikiteisminis tyrimas.

lithuania.title: LAT: medicinos įstaigos duomenis ištrynusios moters byla turės būti nagrinėjama iš naujo
lithuania.description: Lietuvos Aukščiausiasis Teismas (LAT) nusprendė, kad byla, kurioje moteris buvo nuteista dėl neteisėto neviešų elektroninių duomenų stebėjimo ir panaudojimo, apeliacine tvarka turės būti nagrinėjama iš naujo.

lithuania.title: Europos, JAV ir Ukrainos derybininkai trečiadienį susitiks Briuselyje
lithuania.description: Europos Komisija antradienį pranešė, kad Briuselyje trečiadienį rengiamas susitikimas dėl Ukrainos, kuriame dalyvaus Kyjivo, JAV, Prancūzijos, Vokietijos, Jungtinės Karalystės (JK), NATO ir Pasaulio banko atstovai.

lithuania.title: Egzekuciją išgyvenusi Christa Pike prabilo apie skubios pagalbos skyrių
lithuania.description: Kalinė Christa Pike teigia po nepavykusios mirties bausmės vėl patekusi į skubios pagalbos skyrių, o taip pat buvusi priversta valyti tarakonų pilną dušą.

lithuania.title: Prezidentas su Vokietijos kancleriu aptarė Europos saugumo situaciją, pirmininkavimo ES prioritetus
lithuania.description: Su Vokietijos kancleriu Friedrichu Merzu Berlyne susitikęs prezidentas Gitanas Nausėda aptarė dvišalius santykius, gynybos pramonės bendradarbiavimą, Europos saugumą, paramą Ukrainai ir Lietuvos pirmininkavimo Europos Sąjungos (ES) Tarybai prioritetus, antradienį pranešė Prezidentūra.

lithuania.title: Klaipėdos apskrities kelių policijos pareigūnai per savaitę nustatė 8 neblaivius vairuotojus
lithuania.description: Klaipėdos apskrities kelių policijos pareigūnai per savaitę užfiksavo 693 Kelių eismo taisyklių pažeidimus. Spalio 26–lapkričio 2 dienomis nustatyti aštuoni neblaivūs automobilių vairuotojai, dar vienas alkoholio vartojęs vyras važiavo elektrine mikrojudumo priemone.

lithuania.title: Jungtinė Karalystė ir Prancūzija rengia batalioną: kada šie kariai įžengs į Ukrainą
lithuania.description: Jungtinė Karalystė ir Prancūzija rengiasi siųsti karius į Ukrainą pasibaigus karui. Rusijos puolimo prieš europinį kontingentą atveju jiems bus leista atsakyti ugnimi, praneša „The Times“, remdamasis Vakarų pareigūnais.
